_meta.title: Jeremiah — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Jeremiah (known before birth, blessed is the one who trusts, plans of peace, seek me with all your heart, everlasting love, call to me). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 24 Jeremiah); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the book's devotional high points; judgment oracles largely omitted
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
verses.plain: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations.
verses.visual_prompt: an earthenware water pitcher resting on a rough stone bench in a deep tree rooted beside an unfailing stream in a dry year

verses.text: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.
verses.plain: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him.
verses.visual_prompt: a stacked fieldstone cairn beside a winding footpath in a potter's stone workshop in the Hinnom valley

verses.text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
verses.plain: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for peace and not for harm, to give you a future and a hope.
verses.visual_prompt: a quiet stone courtyard archway opening onto the hills in a deep tree rooted beside an unfailing stream in a dry year

verses.text: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
verses.plain: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.
verses.visual_prompt: a stone well in a quiet clearing with a wooden bucket resting on its rim

verses.text: The Lord hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
verses.plain: The Lord appeared to us in the past, saying: I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with unfailing kindness.
verses.visual_prompt: a gnarled fig tree casting open contour lines across rocky ground in a potter's stone workshop in the Hinnom valley

verses.text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
verses.plain: Call to me and I will answer you, and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
verses.visual_prompt: a small stone incense altar in a quiet courtyard corner at daybreak in an almond branch budding in early spring
